blocker.detail: The native image generation tool returned an error before producing an image. Per the image tool contract, generation may not be retried until a new request is given. Therefore exact PNG bytes, PNG signature, dimensions, SHA-256, Git blob identity, and saved-Git visual readback cannot be proven in this scheduled invocation.
blocker.proof_branch_creation_note: Attempting to create proof/native-image-roundtrip in this scheduled invocation was blocked by the platform safety layer before the image attempt. No architectural workaround was introduced.
